epg.description: A widower falls for his son's physical rehabilitation specialist.

epg.title: The Nine Lives Of Christmas
epg.description: 2014 Festive romance with Brandon Routh and Kimberley Sustad. A committed bachelor and a busy vet student have no time for love. But will the arrival of a stray tabby lead to the purr-fect romance?

epg.title: Christmas Wedding Planner
epg.description: 2017 Romantic drama with Jocelyn Hudon. A woman is hired to plan her cousin's elaborate wedding and things are going perfectly - until a handsome stranger arrives asking questions about the groom.

epg.title: Jingle Around the Clock

epg.title: Twinkle All The Way
